items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: You'd see him down on Broadway... So Rudy Toone(?) was on the show... Mae West told me that...

ctx.x: Yeah, he was handsome. You know Rudy Toone(?). He wrote...what's that thing..."One Mint Julep." You'd see him down on Broadway. They killed him, they busted his brains out where Minton's place is. He lived on that block.
